reviewItem.question: For "ServersTransport v1alpha1 schema: 1 field added: `spec.spiffe`", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The ServersTransport v1alpha1 CRD schema adds three new fields under spec.spiffe: ids (an array of strings) and trustDomain (a string), defining SPIFFE configuration with trustDomain as the allowed SPIFFE trust domain and ids taking precedence when specified.
